source: Completed independent read-only audit delivered to parent; this file preserves its verdict and principal findings, not a new physical trial.

verification.images_and_requests: All four selected embedded images match frozen PNGs and receipt hashes; independent CRC/dimension/pixel decoding passed. Each color's complete 889-byte request is identical across native and dual modes and its prompt does not contain the answer.
verification.outputs: Both modes return exactly red and blue respectively, stop, 46 prompt/2 completion/48 total/0 cached reported tokens. Each raw response matches its own hash; response bytes differ across modes.
verification.device_participation: Mini logs identify Apple M4, MTL0 vision encoding, image-processing events, and local/RPC model/KV/recurrent/compute buffers. Local RPC logs identify Apple M2 Pro and repeated 658-node graph_compute calls. This supports actual two-device work, not enumeration alone.
verification.model: Small Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M plus BF16 projector, frozen publisher revision and 739863648 total component bytes; not the target27B.
verification.source_and_parser: Pinned upstream source and selected API build configuration agree with receipts. Immediate left-to-right argument handlers explain why --rpc must register RPC0 before --device resolves it; retained v3/v4 failures/success support the diagnosis.
verification.cleanup: Per-run selected mini/RPC receipts record reaped owned processes and closed listeners; server shutdown/deallocation logs agree. Aggregate all-port/final-pressure assertions were not independently recovered or live-repeated by the reviewer.
verification.hardware_or_network_actions: None; local read-only artifacts and CPU decoding/hashing/source inspection only. No edits by reviewer.

suggestions: Retain durable full model hashes and build manifests including loaded dylibraries for full-target trials.
Archive comprehensive parent cleanup/health readback rather than relying on aggregate prose claims.
Address unauthenticated API/permissive CORS before persistent deployment; loopback alone is not authentication. Keep RPC restricted to the private link.
Retain exact good-order and bad-order argv in future parser regression receipts.
assurance_bounds: Pass applies only to archived bounded small-model image-path proof; not full27B, screenshot grounding, actual GUI actions, numerical/cache/token-ID equivalence, latency statistics or unattended operation.
Reviewer did not independently recompute remote weight files. Selected historical receipts do not bind both complete weight digests.
Source/executable fingerprints and logs are not cryptographic attestation of every loaded dependency or an independent GPU trace.
Computed receipt hashes are fingerprints, not independent authentication or an externally signed immutable anchor.
Future pre-target build snapshots cannot retroactively strengthen the historic process's loaded-artifact attestation.
Experimental RPC and the historical unauthenticated loopback API are bounded-test risks, not a secure service qualification.
